what: iOS 27 compact UIDatePicker on the device: the overlay opening and closing, the date-and-time switch, the time wheels
probe: tool/ios_reference scene x3date (Sources/Extras.swift, X3Sampler) driven by UITests/ExtrasUITests.swift testX3Video (synthesized touches) while MorphRecorder filmed the screen
rows: start; touch (phase 0 down, 3 up); V cls _UIDatePickerOverlayPlatterView (center x, y, size w, h, bounds bw, bh, transform sx, opacity a, effective alpha ea); in vid-both also _UIDatePickerCalendarView and _UIDatePickerView (the calendar's and the wheels' effective alpha ea through the switch)

files.vid-date.jsonl: picker centered 300 pt from the top: a 0.6 s press on the label (opens on the lift), month paging, a day, a tap outside (close), then synthesized open/close strokes (one record fires its strokes together - only the last open and its close are usable)
files.vid-both.jsonl: date-and-time picker: the date label opens the calendar, a tap on the time label turns the open overlay into the wheels, a tap outside closes
files.wheels.json: the time overlay's labels at rest: rows fs 21 at ea 0.447 outside the band, fs 23.5 inside it, the band 200 x 32
files.tm-openclose-050.jsonl: (2026-10-03 leftovers pass, ExtrasUITests.testX3Timing) a tap on the label, a filler stroke held 0.05 s at an inert point, a tap outside while the overlay opens; rows: touch, V (id, sx, a, bh) of _UIDatePickerOverlayPlatterView
files.tm-closeopen-050.jsonl: (same pass) an open overlay, a tap outside, a filler held 0.05 s, a tap on the label while it closes: a NEW platter (second id) opens while the first finishes its close
files.tm-openclose-150.jsonl: (2026-10-03 leftovers pass, ExtrasUITests.testX3Timing) a tap on the label, a filler stroke held 0.15 s at an inert point, a tap outside while the overlay opens; rows: touch, V (id, sx, a, bh) of _UIDatePickerOverlayPlatterView
files.tm-closeopen-150.jsonl: (same pass) an open overlay, a tap outside, a filler held 0.15 s, a tap on the label while it closes: a NEW platter (second id) opens while the first finishes its close
files.tm-openclose-300.jsonl: (2026-10-03 leftovers pass, ExtrasUITests.testX3Timing) a tap on the label, a filler stroke held 0.30 s at an inert point, a tap outside while the overlay opens; rows: touch, V (id, sx, a, bh) of _UIDatePickerOverlayPlatterView
files.tm-closeopen-300.jsonl: (same pass) an open overlay, a tap outside, a filler held 0.30 s, a tap on the label while it closes: a NEW platter (second id) opens while the first finishes its close
files.my-light.jsonl: light: open, tap the month title (wheels), month wheel +1, year wheel -1, title (grid), title + filler + title 0.12 s apart, title (wheels), tap outside, reopen. (2026-10-03 month-year pass, ExtrasUITests.testX3MonthYear / testX3MonthYearCases, PROBE_X3MY) rows: touch, evt valueChanged (v = epoch seconds UTC), anim (CABasicAnimation opacity of the weekday view, the selector, the month buttons), V of _UICalendarWeekdayView and _UICalendarMonthYearSelector (a), chevron (the title chevron image frame w x h, 10.33 x 14 turned), title (the month title text and color)
